what: The one table both validators answer to. js/sources.js runs in the reader's browser; tools/check-source.py runs here on GitHub. Two rule sets that quietly disagree are worse than one, because the one people check is not the one that runs. Each case is a record and whether it must be let in. The field `kind` picks which rule set judges it, exactly as the site does.
read_by: tools/check-cases.py, on every push to this repository
tools/agree-selftest.html, in the site, opened by hand
